name: dale
description: Focused brainstorming, evidence-backed repository knowledge, adaptive subagent work, independent verification, resumable workflows, and HTML visualization for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Dale scales from direct work to coordinated subagents with explicit ownership and evidence. Separate user-owned tasks are optional on request. Task-matched Luna and Sol routing is preserved; Cross asks for user-selected Claude, GPT, and Gemini models per role through T3 Code. Includes brainstorming, coaching, indexing, reasoning lenses, review loops, monitoring, technical proof, and standalone visualization.
defaultPrompt: Brainstorm this idea with me one-on-one.
Review how I use Codex across my recent tasks with Dale Coach.
Apply the strongest Dale reasoning lens to this difficult problem.
Monitor this PR with Dale Loop PR.
Watch this source for meaningful changes with Dale Loop Watch.
Run this consequential task through Dale Max.
Choose a model for each needed role and coordinate this task with Dale Cross.
Verify this technical claim with Dale Proof.
Turn this material into a standalone HTML visualization.
